explanation: Farsi comes from Parsi, after the region of Pars. Arabic has no p sound, so after the Arab conquest Parsi became Farsi. Persian is also spoken in Afghanistan and Tajikistan.

claims.text: Persian (Farsi) is the official and main language of Iran.
The main languages of Iraq, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia are not Persian.
Farsi is the Arabicized form of Parsi, named after the region of Pars (Fars).
Arabic has no p sound in its standard consonants.
Varieties of Persian are spoken in Afghanistan (Dari) and Tajikistan (Tajik).
